pages.title: Source Role
pages.text: This entry maps tianyuan_merit_economy.json#pressure_resist_charm, secret_realms.json#diyuan, spirit_herbs_catalog.json#diyuan_pressure_moss, and tribulation_rules.json#diyuan_pressure. The charm is the short-duration talisman route for Diyuan pressure survival.

pages.title: Current Use
pages.text: seeking_immortals:pressure_resist_charm can now be used with right click at Void Refinement or higher. It writes half a day of pressure-resist time, clears pressure slowness and nausea, and grants brief resistance plus movement feedback. It refuses to waste a charm when enough timer already remains.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: The first shapeless recipe uses paper, seeking_immortals:diyuan_pressure_moss, seeking_immortals:armor_talisman, and a mid-grade metal spirit stone. The Tianyuan Merit Exchange also keeps its 200 alliance_merit_token purchase path.

pages.title: Pill Relation
pages.text: Pressure-Resist Pills provide a longer base timer; the charm is an emergency warding pattern. Both use the same server-side pressure-resist state and both block the current Diyuan pressure loop. Future slices still need Diyuan gathering, loot placement, quest routing, dedicated visuals, and deeper pressure rules.
